definitions.explanation: A company other than one's own. Used in business contexts to refer to rival companies, partner companies, or simply any other company.

examples.japanese: {他社|たしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I compared it with other companies' products.

examples.japanese: {他社|たしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{先駆|さきが}けて⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We released the new product ahead of our competitors.

examples.japanese: {他社|たしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差別化|さべつか}→差別化：18681_sabetsuka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}させた→向上させる：23131_koujousaseru⟧。
examples.english: We improved service quality in order to differentiate ourselves from other companies.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{他|た}→他：03381_ta⟧ (other) + ⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧ (company). A standard business term used to refer to any company other than one's own. Does not necessarily imply competition — can also refer to partner companies or companies in unrelated industries.

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Not to be confused with ⟦{他者|たしゃ}→他者：11606_tasha⟧ (another person, the other), which uses a different second kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {他社|たしゃ}⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧ (other companies' products)
- {他社|たしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧ (comparison with other companies)
- {他社|たしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}けない→負ける：01134_makeru⟧ (not to lose to competitors)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{競合他社|きょうごうたしゃ}→競合他社：25602_kyougoutasha⟧: competing company — specifically a rival
- ⟦{自社|じしゃ}→自社：14070_jisha⟧: one's own company — the opposite
